141.contributorBio: Anne Collins Duch has been a physical therapist for 27 years, specializing in pelvic health for 25 of those years. She was pelvic health board certified in 2010, which was right about the time she also completed her 200 hr yoga teacher training. She specializes in medical complexities  (i.e. endometriosis, Elhers Danlos, menopause, and other undiagnosed things that “don’t make sense”, bringing a holistic approach to healing from the inside...out.

146.contributorBio: Becky Allen is a doctor of physical therapy with a specialty in women's health physical therapy, and the founder of  Genesis PT & Wellness.  She’s passionate about treating every person as a whole, not as just an injury, pain or dysfunction.

149.contributorBio: Dr. Deanna Lewis, DrPH, PA-C, RYT-200, is a doctor with expertise in public health, clinical medicine, and therapeutic movement through yoga. As both a clinician working in the urgent care setting and certified yoga instructor, she takes an evidence-based approach to wellness, helping women maintain strength, flexibility, and balance through the transitions of perimenopause and menopause. Her work focuses on integrating leisure time physical activity (LTPA) as a key component of long-term health, addressing the unique physiological changes of this stage while promoting overall vitality.

152.qualificationsTitle: Functional Diagnostic Nutritionist Specializing in Perimenopause
152.contributorBio: Jennifer Woodward, a functional diagnostic nutritionist, is a women’s hormonal health expert who has helped over 1,200 women transform their health. After overcoming her own hormonal crisis, she now empowers women to thrive through perimenopause with clarity and confidence. She is the author of the book Easy Perimenopause.

155.contributorBio: Dr. Celia P. Valenzuela is an obstetrician-gynecologist in Tucson, Arizona and is affiliated with multiple hospitals in the area. She received her medical degree from University of Arizona College of Medicine-Tucson and has been in practice for more than 20 years. Her greatest joy, outside of medicine, is motherhood. She has been richly blessed with a loving husband, three wonderful children and an incredible career.

158.contributorBio: Joy is a certified family nurse practitioner with 18 years of experience in reproductive and sexual health. After navigating her own perimenopause journey, she is passionate about helping women feel seen, heard, and supported through every stage of midlife.

161.contributorBio: Kara has a Master's Degree in Social Work from the University of Michigan, and has extensive experience treating individuals with chronic health conditions, infertility and perinatal loss, perinatal mood disorders, pelvic pain, depression, anxiety, conflict in relationships, life and career transitions, healthcare clinicians, and corporate leaders. She has a special passion in helping women feel empowered around their sex life and intimacy.

164.contributorBio:
Dr. Greenlee is a board-certified and specialty-trained (Consult Liaison & Reproductive Psychiatry) adult psychiatrist, who specializes in providing holistic psychiatric care that is culturally attuned and authentically prepared to provide superb care to diverse communities.

She is the founder and owner of Bloom & Build Integrative Psychiatry, a private practice that offers individual therapy, couples therapy, family therapy, and psychiatry services that integrates traditional Western medications, complementary and alternative medications, and lifestyle medicine. She is also a collaborative care psychiatrist, at Santa Rosa Community Health, who supports primary care providers and frequently diagnoses and treats patients with mood disorders, perinatal mood disorders, ADHD, bipolar disorder, and psychosis.

207.contributorBio:
Jeanice Mitchell is a pelvic health Physical Therapist, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. She founded myPFM, a non-profit pelvic health public service campaign, in 2018. Jeanice has also completed numerous continuing education courses and is proud to have completed the Herman and Wallace pelvic health series as well as the APTA SoWH pelvic health series. She obtained her board certification in biofeedback for pelvic floor muscle dysfunction in 2010.

Jeanice’s passion is to share hope, help, and healing with the billions of people that are suffering from pelvic health dysfunction world-wide. Her vision for myPFM is “Pelvic Health for All. Everyone. Everywhere. Every Language.” Her fervent desire is that pelvic health awareness and hope may reach as many people as possible, in as many places as possible, regardless of ethnicity, language, socioeconomic status, religious beliefs, or any other perceived barriers.

3793.contributorBio:
Dr. Brittney Penberthy is a board-certified endodontist at Northwest Endodontics in both Coeur D’Alene, ID and Sandpoint, ID.

Brittney grew up in Post Falls, ID, attended Rocky Mountain College in Billings, MT, and graduated Magna Cum Laude from Creighton Dental School in Omaha, NE. She then completed an AEGD residency through Lutheran Medical Center in Billings, MT. Upon completion of her AEGD residency, she began her endodontic residency at Texas A&M Dental School in Dallas, TX.

Brittney is an endodontist specialist with extensive training in root canals, root canal surgeries and Cone Beam CT Scan reading and diagnosis. Board certified with the American Board of Endodontists, she is the first and only female board-certified endodontist in the state of Idaho.

170.contributorBio: Dee has been teaching Pilates and strength training for 15 years. She is a certified menopause coach, pregnancy + postpartum specialist as well as a Level 3 Fascia Stretch Therapist. She lives in Hamilton, Ontario with her family, loves tacos, spicy noodles, hiking and travelling any chance she gets.

174.qualificationsTitle: Women's Health and Fitness Specialist, Barre Instructor
174.contributorBio:
Liz Cuttica is the founder of Milly Grey Movement, a women’s health and fitness specialist, and a Certified Pregnancy and Postpartum Corrective Exercise Specialist. With extensive training alongside orthopedic and pelvic floor physical therapists, Liz specializes in helping women build strength, prevent injury, and move with confidence through every phase of life, including pregnancy, postpartum, perimenopause, and menopause.

Liz has developed barre programs specifically designed for women navigating perimenopause and menopause, using targeted, low-impact movements to enhance strength, stability, and longevity. Her approach emphasizes functional movement and proper execution, ensuring women feel strong and supported as they transition through different life stages.

178.contributorBio: Crys Tal has been a personal trainer and teacher for 20 years. She discovered Ashtanga yoga in 2017 and fell in love with the method. She is now a 200 hour RYT. She loves all things yoga, fitness and nutrition, and is drawn to Ashtanga because she finds it to be a balanced practice. According to her, "There isn't a single part of my body that ever feels left out of this practice!"

181.contributorBio: Passionate in her conviction that yoga should be accessible for all, Gina teaches local yoga classes to women of all ages. Her focus is on postpartum and menopausal body and mind changes. After adapting her personal practice to support multiple postpartum pelvic organ prolapses, Gina created a way of teaching yoga in which the breath supports the core and pelvic floor. She has received education in pelvic floor yoga and yoga nidra. Yoga nidra, a systematic form of meditation, is another facet of Gina's classes that supports the mind and spirit of the women she teaches. Yoga nidra allows her students to calm, reset, and clear their minds.

184.qualificationsTitle: Personal Trainer and Menopause Coaching Specialist
184.contributorBio: Kaitlin is a NASM Certified Personal Trainer, Performance Enhancement Specialist, and Menopause Coaching Specialist. She believes fitness is more than just your physical appearance…it is an act of self love, self care, and self acceptance. She brings knowledge and humor to the world of fitness, helping women find their mojo in midlife and beyond.

187.contributorBio: Dr. Deanna Lewis, DrPH, PA-C, is a public health expert, clinician, and educator specializing in women’s health through a trauma-informed lens. With over two decades of experience, she is committed to providing evidence-based education that acknowledges the complex physical, emotional, and social factors influencing perimenopause and menopause. Her approach prioritizes safety, empowerment, and informed decision-making, ensuring that women feel heard, validated, and equipped with practical knowledge about their changing bodies. By translating medical research into accessible, real-world insights, Dr. Lewis helps women navigate this transition with confidence, self-compassion, and a greater sense of control over their health and well-being.

229.qualificationsTitle: Menovation Founder & Certified Menopause Coaching Specialist
229.contributorBio:
Ashley Nowe is a certified personal trainer with specializations in pre and postnatal corrective exercise, menopause coaching, and nutrition health coaching.

Ashley founded Menovation in 2025, determined to break the silence around menopause. She realized that there was very little information around fitness, pelvic health, and nutrition to help women transition through perimenopause and beyond. Ashley brought together the best in fitness, pelvic health, and the medical field to empower women through midlife.

Ashley has been dedicated to transforming women's health for nearly a decade. Her first app, Strong Like A Mother by Get Mom Strong, has helped more than 80,000 women with total body fitness and pelvic health throughout motherhood.

167.contributorBio: Kristin McGee is a nationally recognized yoga and Pilates teacher, speaker, mompreneur, and author. With over three decades of experience in the fitness and wellness space, she has had a continuous roster of high profile celebrities, pioneered the launch of Peloton’s yoga and Pilates program, and recently branched out on her own to launch Kristin McGee Movement.

5580.contributorBio: Dr. Becky Allen is a pelvic health physical therapist and the founder of Genesis PT & Wellness. She’s passionate about helping women move past quick fixes and using mobility and movement to support the pelvic floor as part of the bigger system.

5610.contributorBio: With a strong passion for pelvic health, Dr. Hailey is on a mission to make pelvic floor therapy a standard part of care for both women and men. Originally from Arizona, Dr. Hailey graduated from the University of New Mexico before earning her Doctorate in Physical Therapy from the University of North Texas Health Science Center in Fort Worth. Her journey began in the fitness industry, where 11 years as a personal trainer sparked a desire to help others on a deeper level.

5609.contributorBio: Melissa (DPT, E-RYT, CDNT) is a Doctor of Physical Therapy, yoga instructor, and women’s health specialist on a mission to help women feel strong, supported, and confident in their bodies. After years in sports medicine and orthopedics, Melissa discovered her true passion: pelvic health. What started as helping individual clients in her private practice quickly grew into a global vision. Through her online platform, Defy, she’s empowered thousands of women worldwide to stop leaks, ease pain, release tension, and rebuild strength through movement that actually works.Melissa combines science, movement, and mindfulness in a way that’s practical, approachable, and life-changing. She teaches women to understand their bodies, reclaim control over their core and pelvic floor, and live powerfully without endless Kegels, guesswork, or frustration. Her goal is simple: to help as many pelvic floors as possible feel confident, strong, and at home in their bodies.

5600.contributorBio:
Shaelyn Delgado is a yoga educator and teacher trainer with over 16 years of teaching experience and more than a decade of guiding self-myofascial release and therapeutic movement practices. She holds over 1,000 hours of advanced training and certifications, many through the internationally recognized Yoga Medicine program, including Yoga for Athletes, Yoga Anatomy, Anatomy of the Spine, Yoga for Women’s Health, Myofascial Release, and Chinese Medicine.

Shaelyn specializes in mentoring and training yoga teachers, with a focus on experiential anatomy, therapeutic sequencing, and intelligent strength-based movement. Her work centers on adapting yoga and recovery practices to support women across all stages of life, helping them build resilience, body literacy, and sustainable strength. She is deeply passionate about empowering people through tools like self-myofascial release, education, and mindful training strategies so they can take an active role in their long-term health, performance, and well-being.

5604.contributorBio: Candace has been practicing yoga since 2017 and got her certification in November 2019. Yoga has been amazing with helping her connect her core to her body and feel stronger in general. It’s calming but at the same time empowering. Candace wants to help other mamas feel connected with their bodies, embrace where they are today, and be thankful that they have an amazing body.

5607.contributorBio: With 15+ years of experience and deep roots in health and wellness, Jackie's holistic philosophy has been influenced by the mind/body connection, stress management, connective tissue repair, and the synergistic relationship between mobility and stability. Through her experience practicing these ideologies with a wide-range of populations as well as in her own journey, Jackie has developed a deep passion for helping women to feel strong, healthy, and empowered through education and movement.
